name: palindrome_chorus
title: Back-to-back palindrome into spectral chorus
material: any mono source with a distinct tail - swells, reversed hits, phrases
description: extend baktobak reverses everything AFTER the join point and prepends it, making a sample-exact palindrome around the join; blur chorus then thickens the result with spectral amplitude and frequency spread (deterministic - no seed exists), and modify loudness brings it back to the time domain.
source: Both wave-4 entries verified in tranche 10 (docs/curation/tranche10a_st_singles.md, tranche10b_st_singles.md).
notes: baktobak DISCARDS audio before join_time (curated finding - not a whole-file prepend): output duration is exactly 2 * (indur - join_time).
join_time == input duration exits 0 with a 1-frame file - keep it well inside the file.
blur chorus is fully deterministic (no RNG seeding in the binary) - same params, same bytes.
